payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of training set sizes for ELMo models, indicating that newer models are trained on significantly larger datasets than previous versions.

claims.text: The original ELMo model was trained on a one billion word corpus, while the newer models for languages like Latvian were trained on 270 million tokens, compared to 20 million tokens used by ELMoForManyLangs.
New ELMo embeddings were trained on larger training sets, which significantly improved their performance compared to previous models.
